s:service.name: AutomationService
s:service.s:description: Entry points for the automation service, which supports building IFTTT-style automation chains from composable building blocks.

s:method.name: ListAutomations
s:method.description: Lists all automations defined for a given place

s:method.name: GetStartingPoints
s:method.description: Returns the available trigger types for building a new automation

s:return.name: triggers
s:return.description: Available trigger blocks grouped by category, each with type, label, and parameter schema

s:method.name: GetNextSteps
s:method.description: Given a partial chain, returns the available next steps (conditions or actions)

s:return.name: conditions
s:return.description: Available condition blocks that can be added

s:method.name: Create
s:method.description: Creates a new automation from a complete chain

s:return.name: automation
s:return.description: The address of the created automation
